description: Resize images to a width, a height or both. fit "inside" keeps the whole picture within the box, "cover" fills the box and crops (keeping the interesting part), "contain" fits it whole and pads the rest. Never enlarges unless asked. Social sizes: see the one-design://presets/sizes resource. Saved as name-WIDTHxHEIGHT.ext.

background.description: Padding colour for fit "contain" (hex, or "transparent" for PNG/WebP).

enlarge.description: Allow making images bigger than they are.

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

format.description: Output format. "original" keeps each file’s own (HEIC, AVIF and TIFF become JPEG, GIF becomes PNG).

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

percent.description: Scale by a percentage instead of a size (e.g. 50).

name: resize_images
title: Resize images
